mapper.select: SELECT * FROM basic_resource ORDER BY pinned_yn DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO basic_resource ( title, content, status, pinned_yn, view_cnt, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{pinnedYn}, 0, NOW(), #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE basic_resource SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, pinned_yn = #{pinnedYn}, updated_at = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
